text: Coffee loaded. Brain booting. Let's do this.
Welcome back, Captain! I haven't seen you for 14 hours, 3 minutes and 12 seconds.
Not that I was counting.
This is C-Cube. A palm-sized desktop AI assistant. You can talk to it, and it's always in a good mood.
I designed the cube together with an AI, in just a few days.
From the first idea to the finished model, we built everything in conversation.
I didn't draw the 3D model with a mouse. The AI wrote a program that builds it in Fusion.
Not everything worked the first time. We found the bugs together, and fixed them.
In the end, the AI reviewed the model in Fusion by itself, and even suggested colors.
And every step went into the log.
Round display. Camera. Two microphones. Stereo speakers. RGB lights. Battery. And orange rubber corners. Why? You'll see in a moment.
With music, the lights dance too.
What do you call a tree that fits in your hand?
A palm tree!
Ouch!
That's 14 throws today. Coffee break?
Yes. Obviously.
If you don't want to be disturbed, it only gives a gentle buzz.
It connects to your phone, and works as a speakerphone too.
Hey, you look tired. Want to hear a terrible joke?
Turn it upside down, and the microphone and camera switch off.
Good morning, sunshine!
Breathe in. The emails can wait.
Let's gooooo!
Oh great. Monday.
Or build your own.
C-Cube. A little friend for your desk. And my first project made together with an AI.
See you tomorrow, Captain!
